name: EOS
basedOn: Hiwatt DR103, plus the Comfortably Numb solo tones
description: Eos got a full makeover and two packs mixed into one head. Underneath is the Hiwatt DR103: CHANNEL picks Normal, Brilliant or Linked (both inputs jumped, the classic Hiwatt trick), and Volume steps through the real captures on each one. DRIVE adds the pack's pedal captures. The ivory SOLO selector is the second pack: turn it away from OFF and it clicks through seven Comfortably Numb solo tones (Studio, DSOT, Pulse, RTN, Gdansk, Pompeii, Rome), which take over until you turn it back to OFF.
pack: Hiwatt Custom 100 DR103 1974 + Pink Floyd Comfortably Numb Tone Collection
kind: Amp only (Hiwatt) and full rig (solo tones)
